notes.title: Just a Village Clicker Update!
notes.content:
Hello Villagers!

First of all, I would like to thank everyone who bought the game!
Thank you very much, I’m really happy with the results and the feedback!

We are starting the year with a small update to improve the user experience.
Check out the changes!

Fix:
Reducing the enemy's armor to below 0 now correctly amplifies the damage instead of healing.

Update:
Battles don't last long, so we’re reducing the cooldown time so they can be used more than once in battle:
Cooldown time for spells reduced to 12s.

All the best!
Ankouz

notes.title: Just a Village Clicker Launch
notes.content:
Hello villagers, is everyone in the Christmas spirit?

Today is the launch of Just a Village Clicker, and I’m really happy that everything is going smoothly so far!

I’ll be keeping an eye out during the holiday season to make sure all players have a good gaming experience, so if there’s anything you’d like to report, I’ll try to resolve it as quickly as possible.

I think that’s all for today!

All the best!

Ankouz

notes.title: TOMORROW is the big day! Some information about the game!
notes.content:
Hello again, villagers!

Tomorrow is the launch of Just a Village Clicker!
I'm a little anxious, but also really happy!

As I mentioned in the last post, I wanted to talk a bit about the game before the launch.

Mechanics
There are no direct tutorials in the game because the mechanics are very simple: Click on things.
Click on the mine, click on the forest, click on upgrades, click on enemies, click on buttons. It's all about clicking... So, if you have any doubts: Click!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340010/36a2bc21342a3b13b1d2ec8e2469d13b876fcad1.png


Characters
The villagers will interact with you when you purchase an upgrade or unlock a new building. They will tell you about their stories, goals, or talk about other villagers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340010/54f988485ee6491d9ff24302e72b6cc9f2305a6b.png


Combat
The combat is simple but tough! You will always face 6 enemies that will attack you at regular intervals. You need to defeat them before your HP drops to 0.
To help you, you have 4 spells that can completely change the course of battle.
Do the enemies have high regeneration? Use Fireball!
Is your health too low? Heal yourself!
Are the enemies too resistant to your damage? Break their armor!
Are the enemies attacking too fast? Slow them down with Icy Wind!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340010/50f9acee94b47fa2eecb35eabb5fc94e7c8d745f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340010/36cc24c18e6de59eecd5a22c64f9414321cad09c.png

Buildings
In the village, by unlocking buildings, you will gain access to new mechanics and upgrades!
I won’t give any spoilers yet, but all of them will help you a lot!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340010/56b83ddcf421e7ab2b525dbab0ce85bc27d1c14d.png


I hope you enjoy the game!

If you have any questions, feel free to ask and I’ll be more than happy to answer!

Big hug!
Ankouz

notes.title: Release date of Just a Village Clicker scheduled for 12/24/24
notes.content:
Hello villagers!

After a few months of development, we have a release date for Just a Village Clicker!

The game will be released on December 24, 2024, one day before Christmas, so... How about gifting this relaxing little game to someone important to you? Hehe.

This is my first time publishing a game on a major platform, so I'm definitely very anxious about all of this, but I'm doing my best to deliver a quality and fun project for the player.

I know there might still be some errors and bugs, but it seems that everything is going according to plan. A big thank you to the testers for helping me polish this final stage!

Soon, I want to talk more about the game's narrative and some mechanics, so stay tuned!

Wishing you a great end of the year <3

- Ankouz
